oracle: Pinned GGML generic CPU object, single-threaded, with contraction disabled.
columns: state width, scalar-decay flag, head width, tokens, slots, groups, padded-view flag, repeated-ID flag, followed by hexadecimal binary32 output words
geometry: Four heads, two sequences, three initial state rows. Sequence IDs are [2,0] or [1,1]. X has head width lanes and four heads. B and C have state width lanes and one or two groups. Padded X/B/C use a base with one extra head or group and one extra token, retain the base strides, and start at its second row. All other tensors are contiguous.
inputs: For slot s in [initial state,X,dt,A,B,C], set n=i0+7*i1+11*i2+13*i3+5*s. A=-(1+n%13)/16. dt=21 when n%5==0 and n%17-8 otherwise. Remaining inputs=(n%19-9)/16. Initialize the complete result to 13.25.
baseline: The pre-SSM provider refused the first graph. For zero tokens the upstream CPU preserves all snapshot slots.

negative_controls: second sequence ID equal to cache capacity
provider_comparison.condition: Every refusal left the complete score and snapshot destination byte-identical.
